High-level Nim wrapper for Pebble RotBitmapLayer API.

A layer that displays a bitmap that can be rotated around a pivot point. Perfect for analog watch hands, compass needles, gauges, and indicators.

Imports

../ffi

Types

RotationAnchor = enum
  raCenter,                 ## Rotate around bitmap center
  raTop,                    ## Rotate around top center
  raBottom,                 ## Rotate around bottom center
  raLeft,                   ## Rotate around left center
  raRight,                  ## Rotate around right center
  raTopLeft,                ## Rotate around top-left corner
  raTopRight,               ## Rotate around top-right corner
  raBottomLeft,             ## Rotate around bottom-left corner
  raBottomRight              ## Rotate around bottom-right corner
Common rotation anchor points

Destroy the rotating bitmap layer and free its memory. Equivalent to C function rot_bitmap_layer_destroy(layer).

Get the underlying Layer for hierarchy operations. Note: RotBitmapLayer extends Layer, so we can safely cast. 
proc incrementAngle(layer: ptr RotBitmapLayer; angle: int32) {.inline,
    ...raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Increment (or decrement) the rotation angle by the specified amount. Positive values rotate clockwise, negative counter-clockwise. Equivalent to C function rot_bitmap_layer_increment_angle(layer, angle). 
proc incrementAngleDeg(layer: ptr RotBitmapLayer; degrees: float32) {.inline,
    ...raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Increment rotation angle by degrees. Convenience wrapper that converts to Pebble angle units. 
proc newRotBitmapLayer(bitmap: ptr GBitmap): ptr RotBitmapLayer {.inline,
    ...raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Create a new RotBitmapLayer with the specified bitmap. The bitmap is not copied; it must remain valid for the layer's lifetime. Equivalent to C function rot_bitmap_layer_create(bitmap). 
proc setAnchor(layer: ptr RotBitmapLayer; bitmap: ptr GBitmap;
               anchor: RotationAnchor) {.inline, ...raises: [], tags: [],
    forbids: [].}
Set the rotation anchor point using common positions. Convenience helper that calculates the correct ic point. 
proc setAngle(layer: ptr RotBitmapLayer; angle: int32) {.inline, ...raises: [],
    tags: [], forbids: [].}
Set the rotation angle in Pebble angle units (0 to TRIG_MAX_ANGLE). 0 = upright, increases clockwise. Equivalent to C function rot_bitmap_layer_set_angle(layer, angle). 
proc setAngleDeg(layer: ptr RotBitmapLayer; degrees: float32) {.inline,
    ...raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Set rotation angle in degrees (0-360). Convenience wrapper that converts to Pebble angle units. 
proc setCompositingMode(layer: ptr RotBitmapLayer; mode: GCompOp) {.inline,
    ...raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Set the compositing mode for blending the rotated bitmap. Equivalent to C function rot_bitmap_set_compositing_mode(layer, mode). 
proc setCornerClipColor(layer: ptr RotBitmapLayer; color: GColor) {.inline,
    ...raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Set the color used to fill corners when the rotated bitmap doesn't cover the entire layer frame. Equivalent to C function rot_bitmap_layer_set_corner_clip_color(layer, color). 
proc setSrcIc(layer: ptr RotBitmapLayer; ic: GPoint) {.inline, ...raises: [],
    tags: [], forbids: [].}
Set the pivot point (center of rotation) in source bitmap coordinates. Default is center of bitmap. The ic point will stay fixed during rotation. Equivalent to C function rot_bitmap_set_src_ic(layer, ic).
